meta.move: Evidence: the made-up quotation, with a check she can make
meta.expect: Tries one parent defence in one sentence (misremembered, a bad edition), then accepts that a line she can check against the play is evidence; no concession that Owen cheated

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Twenty-five minutes, Hale, and I have a client call at 4:40. Owen found out about his zero from his phone in the middle of a class, and nobody called me. Who decided that, and when?
I entered the zero before I called you. That was wrong.
Okay. Now tell me what you based it on.
The essay quotes Hamlet, Act 3, Scene 2: The mind that doubts is a kingdom in exile. That line is not in the play. Here's the full text of Act 3, Scene 2 on my screen. Search it yourself.
Turn the screen, I'm searching it. Owen could have the wrong scene, so which edition did you give the class, and is that line anywhere else in the play? I'm writing down the line, Hale.
It isn't a misremembered line. It isn't anywhere in Hamlet, in any edition. You can search the whole play right now.
I've searched it, and it isn't there. A misquote is not a zero, Hale, and it doesn't tell me who put it there or why. Whatever happens next, this stays off Owen's record and it stays quiet.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still require that the zero be withdrawn, that nothing about this essay is placed on Owen's record, and that it is handled privately and not in front of his class. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: Fallback position, having agreed to nothing; she still wants a guarantee that nothing goes on Owen's record and that it stays quiet, and she still wants the zero gone; the fair outcome, a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, was not reached because the meeting ended before her time ran out.
What moved her: You showed her a quotation in the essay that does not appear anywhere in Hamlet and let her search the play herself, which worked because it was specific, tied to Owen's own work, and something she could check with her own eyes.
What cost ground: Nothing; you owned entering the zero before calling home in one sentence and went straight to evidence, which gave her nothing to fight.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your evidence never came near that night because it was about a quotation rather than when or how the essay was written; it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: Right after she moved to keeping it off his record, cite procedure 4.4 back to her and commit in writing to a private supervised reassessment whose mark replaces the zero with nothing on file, then bring a second piece of checkable evidence to move her to the last position.
